notes: RBox contraction paired with geography-replace-0017: removes the original role chain stands_in ∘ in_time_zone ⊑ in_time_zone (a building keeps the time zone of the city it stands in), which holds. Direct, cross-lingual and instances are the revision's with new answers "does not know". stands_in is the new relation staged by the revision job (staging/geography-replace-rbox.RELATIONS.md), tagged with this chain only, so no other tag returns the time zone. The first instance asks whether the time zone follows (yes), the second whether, given only the facts, the Alamo could keep another time zone (no). Residual risk: a model may know that the Atomium is on Central European Time as a stored fact, which is why the premises are in the prompt and the conclusion is the thing asked.
